description: AI agent that analyzes database migration assessment results and generates actionable migration plans, answers migration questions, and creates reports.

data_sources.description: Assessment results stored by the Docker assessment engine

topics.name: Get Assessment Summary
trigger_phrases: how ready are we to migrate

flow.prompt: Which customer assessment would you like to review?

Based on the assessment data for {customerName}, provide a clear summary including: overall readiness, databases that are ready vs need work, any critical blockers, and top 3 recommended next steps. Format as a structured report.
For which customer should I generate a migration plan?

Create a detailed migration wave plan for {customerName}. Wave 1: databases with score >= 80 (Ready). Wave 2: score 60-79 (Conditionally Ready, after addressing gaps). Wave 3: score 40-59 (after preparation). Wave 4: complex/heterogeneous. For each database include: recommended migration tool, estimated effort, prerequisites, and success criteria. Flag any blockers prominently.

topics.name: Explain Migration Path
trigger_phrases: what is the best way to migrate

flow.prompt: What is the source database type and target?

Explain the Azure migration path for {sourceDB}. Include: recommended Azure target service, migration tool (DMS / SSMA / ora2pg / etc.), whether online or offline migration is supported, typical effort, key prerequisites, and any gotchas specific to this migration type.

flow.text: To start a new assessment, please use the Power Apps DB Migration Readiness tool, fill in the database inventory, and submit. I'll be able to analyze the results once the assessment completes (typically within a few minutes).

flow.prompt: Which blocker would you like help resolving? (e.g., Landing Zone, Network Connectivity, Zero-downtime)

Provide step-by-step guidance to resolve the following migration blocker for an Azure database migration: {blockerType}. Include relevant Azure documentation links, estimated time to resolve, and who needs to be involved (DBA, Network, Cloud Architect).

flow.text: I can help you export the assessment report. Which format would you like?

power_automate_flows.name: Submit_Assessment_from_PowerApps
power_automate_flows.description: Triggered by Power Apps form submission. Calls Docker API, polls until complete, stores results in Dataverse.

power_automate_flows.name: Export_Assessment_Report
power_automate_flows.description: Exports assessment results from Dataverse to Word or sends as email.

setup_steps: 2. Create new agent: 'DB Migration Readiness Advisor'
3. Add Dataverse as a knowledge source → connect to your Power Platform environment
4. Enable Generative Answers with the knowledge sources listed under fallback_topic
5. Import each topic from this config using the Copilot Studio authoring canvas
6. Publish the agent and embed it in your Power Apps solution
7. Add the Power Automate flows listed above to the same Solution
